name: Intufind – AI Search & Chat
author: intufind

sections.description:
Your visitors search for “comfortable shoes for hiking” and get zero results. That’s because default WordPress search only matches exact keywords — it doesn’t understand what people actually mean.

Intufind fixes that. It replaces your search with AI that understands natural language, adds an intelligent chat assistant, and powers smart product recommendations — all without needing an OpenAI account, API key, or any technical setup.

Install the plugin, activate it, and enter your Intufind Secret Key. Intufind handles the AI on its own servers so you never have to manage tokens, usage limits, or billing with OpenAI, Anthropic, or anyone else.

🎥 See Intufind AI Chat in Action

⚡ How Intufind Is Different From Other AI Plugins

Most WordPress AI plugins are toolkits. They connect your site to external AI providers, but you have to bring your own API key, configure embeddings, choose models, and build the experience yourself. That works for developers. It does not work for store owners who just want better search.

Intufind is not a toolkit. It is a complete, ready to use product.

  • ✅ No OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google API key required
  • ✅ No third party AI account to create or manage
  • ✅ No vector database setup
  • ✅ No prompt engineering or model selection
  • ✅ No usage based billing surprises from external providers
  • ✅ Everything runs through Intufind’s own AI infrastructure

Under the hood, Intufind uses a multi-agent AI architecture with models specifically selected and tuned for each task — search ranking, chat conversations, product recommendations. You get the benefit of that engineering without touching a single setting.

Other AI plugins require your own API keys and developer knowledge to get running. Some customer support platforms offer AI as a premium add-on starting at $29/month or more. Intufind gives you AI search and chat as a finished product starting at $9/month with nothing else to configure.

🔍 Semantic Search

Replaces your default WordPress search with AI that understands natural language. When someone types “something warm but not too bulky” or “gifts under $50 for someone who likes cooking,” Intufind knows what they mean and returns the right results. It handles typos, vague descriptions, and conversational queries without any tuning.

💬 AI Chat Assistant

A built in assistant that guides visitors through your content and products. It answers questions, makes recommendations, and helps people find what they came for. Think of it as a knowledgeable sales associate that never clocks out.

🎯 Smart Recommendations

Context aware suggestions that surface relevant products, posts, and pages your visitors would have missed. Not based on browsing history or cookies. Based on understanding what the visitor is actually looking for.

🤝 Live Agent Handoff

The AI knows when a question needs a human. Complex or sensitive inquiries get routed to your support team seamlessly, so visitors never hit a dead end.

🔄 Auto Sync

When you publish new pages, products, or posts, Intufind picks them up automatically. No re-indexing. No manual updates. Your search results are always current.

🛒 Built for WooCommerce

Intufind scans your entire product catalog including titles, descriptions, pricing, categories, and custom fields. Visitors search the way they think, and Intufind delivers the right products. Fewer dead end searches means more conversions.

🔐 Privacy First

Intufind only indexes publicly available content on your site. It never touches private content, drafts, user data, or personal information.

🚀 Performance

Sub 100ms response times via global edge deployment. 99.9% uptime SLA. Your search will be faster than it has ever been.

🔧 Compatible With

  • WordPress
  • WooCommerce
  • Elementor
  • Gutenberg
  • Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)

Developer API available at developer.intufind.com for custom integrations.

🆓 Getting Started

Install the plugin, activate it, enter your Intufind Secret Key, and you’re live. Intufind begins indexing your content automatically. Most sites are fully searchable within minutes.

Plans start at $9/month with a 14 day free trial. No credit card required.

Use of Third Party Services

This plugin connects to Intufind’s servers to provide AI powered search and chat functionality. When activated, your publicly available site content (pages, posts, and products) is sent to Intufind’s servers for indexing and processing.

  • Intufind – Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

No data is shared with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or any other third party AI provider. All AI processing is handled through Intufind’s own infrastructure.

Privacy

This plugin connects to the Intufind cloud service (intufind.com) to provide AI-powered search and chat functionality.

Data Sent to Intufind

When you connect and sync content, the following data is transmitted to Intufind servers:

  • Post and page content (title, body, excerpt, permalink)
  • Product information for WooCommerce (name, description, price, SKU, categories, images)
  • Taxonomy terms (categories, tags, product attributes)
  • Post meta that is marked as public

Data NOT Collected

  • User personal information (emails, names, addresses)
  • Order details or customer data
  • Passwords or authentication credentials
  • Private or draft content (only published content is synced)
  • Comments or user-generated content

Chat Widget

The chat widget loads from Intufind’s CDN (cdn.intufind.com). When visitors use the chat:

  • Their questions are processed by Intufind’s AI
  • No personally identifiable information is collected
  • Chat conversations are not stored unless you enable analytics in your dashboard

MCP Server (WooCommerce)

If you enable the MCP Orders domain for WooCommerce:

  • Order lookups are performed locally on your WordPress server
  • Order data stays on your server and is not sent to Intufind
  • The Intufind cloud only routes requests to your server

How Order Lookups Work:

When a customer asks about their orders through the chat:

  1. The question is analyzed by Intufind’s AI in the cloud
  2. If it’s an order question, Intufind sends a request back to YOUR WordPress site
  3. Your WordPress plugin looks up the order using WooCommerce
  4. Only the relevant order summary is returned to complete the AI response

The full order database is never accessed by or copied to Intufind servers.

Data Retention

  • Synced content remains in Intufind’s cloud until you disconnect or delete it
  • Disconnecting removes all your indexed content from Intufind servers
  • You can request complete data deletion by contacting support@intufind.com

External Service

This plugin connects to the Intufind cloud service to provide AI-powered features. The plugin and cloud service are developed by the same team. By using this plugin, you agree to Intufind’s:

  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

GDPR Compliance

Intufind is designed with privacy in mind. Since no personal user data is collected or transmitted, standard GDPR consent mechanisms for visitor data are not required. However, you should update your site’s privacy policy to disclose that content is processed by a third-party AI service.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Intufind”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. Go to Intufind → Settings and enter your Secret Key

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to Intufind → Settings to configure

Getting Your Secret Key

  1. Create a free account at intufind.com
  2. Create a workspace for your site
  3. Copy your Secret Key from the workspace settings
  4. Paste it into the plugin settings

No third-party API keys required. Intufind handles all AI processing on its own infrastructure.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI or ChatGPT API key?

No. Intufind runs on its own AI infrastructure. You do not need an account or API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or any other AI provider. Everything is included.

How long does setup take?

Under a minute. Install the plugin, activate it, enter your Intufind Secret Key, and Intufind starts indexing your site automatically. Most sites are fully searchable within a few minutes.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. Intufind works with any WordPress site. WooCommerce integration adds product sync, AI-powered product recommendations, and the MCP Orders domain for AI-powered order management.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Intufind indexes your full product catalog including titles, descriptions, pricing, categories, custom fields, and metadata. It’s built with ecommerce in mind.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Intufind runs on external servers with global edge deployment. It does not add processing load to your WordPress hosting. Response times are under 100ms.

What content does Intufind index?

Intufind indexes publicly available pages, posts, and products on your site. You can configure which post types to sync. It never touches private content, drafts, user accounts, or personal information.

Does the AI chat assistant make things up?

Intufind’s chat assistant responds based on your actual site content. It does not pull from general internet knowledge or generate responses unrelated to your site.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes. You can customize the look and placement of both the search and chat interfaces to match your site’s branding from the Intufind Dashboard.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes. Intufind is compatible with Elementor, Gutenberg, and other popular page builders. It also supports Advanced Custom Fields.

What is MCP?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard for AI agents to interact with external services. Intufind’s MCP server allows AI agents to query orders and perform actions in your WooCommerce store.

What happens after the free trial?

After the 14 day free trial, you can choose a plan starting at $9/month. No credit card is required to start the trial.

Is there a developer API?

Yes. Full API documentation is available at developer.intufind.com for custom integrations and advanced use cases.

How is this different from other AI plugins?

Most AI plugins are developer toolkits that require your own API keys from providers like OpenAI. You configure the models, manage embeddings, and build the search or chat experience yourself. Intufind is a finished product that works immediately with no technical setup.

How is this different from live chat plugins?

Live chat plugins are customer support platforms where AI is typically a premium add-on. Intufind is an AI search and chat product from the ground up, purpose built to help visitors find what they’re looking for and convert. Plans start at $9/month.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All communication with the Intufind cloud uses HTTPS encryption. Your Secret Key is stored securely in your WordPress database and never exposed to visitors.

What happens if I disconnect or uninstall?

When you disconnect from the Settings page, all your indexed content is deleted from Intufind’s servers and all plugin settings are removed. When you uninstall the plugin, it performs the same cleanup automatically.
sections.changelog:
1.2.3

  • Fixed bulk sync failing entirely when batch exceeds plan indexing limit — now processes as many items as will fit
  • Added retry with exponential backoff for rate-limited API requests during bulk sync
  • Fixed error code detection for indexing limit responses
  • Fixed _hash field leaking to API in real-time sync batches

1.2.2

  • Fixed RSS feed requests and bot-like URL patterns being logged as native search queries
  • Added search term validation to filter out junk entries before they reach analytics

1.2.1

  • Fixed search shortcode not opening the modal when clicked before the widget finishes loading
  • Added graceful fallback to native site search if the widget fails to load (CDN/network issues)

1.2.0

  • Fixed $0 price display for WooCommerce variable products and products with a $0 sale price
  • Added price range display for variable products (e.g. “$89.00 – $200.00”)
  • Added separate admin toggle for the floating search trigger button (defaults to off)
  • Added admin toggle to enable/disable the search widget entirely
  • Fixed flash of unstyled content (FOUC) on the [intufind_search] shortcode
  • Added shortcode usage info and styling reference to the Search admin page

1.1.1

  • Declared compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) and block-based Cart/Checkout

1.1.0

  • Added [intufind_search] shortcode for placing an inline search trigger button anywhere on the site
  • Added intufind_search_button() template tag for theme developers
  • Four trigger variants: default, compact, icon, and bar (Spotlight-style)
  • Platform-aware keyboard shortcut badge with auto dark mode, high contrast, and reduced motion support
  • CSS custom properties for easy styling overrides
  • Improved floating search trigger accessibility (focus-visible, reduced motion, high contrast)

1.0.8

  • Fixed orphan cleanup incorrectly deleting valid cloud documents when plan indexing limit is reached during sync
  • Fixed API error handling crash on PHP 8 when error response contains non-string payloads

1.0.7

  • Fixed post type filter not being applied during orphan cleanup, preventing unintended document removal during sync

1.0.6

  • Fixed DELETE API requests to ensure the request body is sent correctly

1.0.5

  • Improved cache invalidation for content deletion to prevent stale data
  • Enhanced bulk sync actions to immediately reflect changes in the cloud
  • Added error handling for cloud deletion failures with appropriate error messages

1.0.4

  • Moved inline CSS to enqueued stylesheet per WordPress coding standards

1.0.3

  • Improved service status messaging for clearer account state communication
  • User-friendly error messages during sync operations
  • Removed internal notices from admin pages for a cleaner experience

1.0.2

  • Fixed WordPress admin notices appearing between page title and subtitle

1.0.1

  • Improved disconnected state UI with clearer service status messaging
  • Connection verification now runs for previously-connected sites
  • Warning status indicator and contextual actions (Reconnect / Manage Account / Change Key)
  • Alert dismiss button now inherits brand color

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • AI-powered semantic search for WordPress and WooCommerce
  • Automatic content sync to Intufind cloud
  • MCP server for AI agent integration (WooCommerce orders)
  • Chat widget integration with cloud-managed configuration
  • Native WordPress and WooCommerce search override options
  • AI-powered product recommendations (WooCommerce)
  • Per-post sync and searchability controls

screenshots.caption: AI Chat Assistant – A knowledgeable shopping assistant on your storefront. Visitors ask natural questions and get personalized product recommendations with images and prices.
Semantic Search Results – Visitors search in their own words like "something elegant for a dinner party" and get relevant results. No exact keyword matching needed.
Smart Recommendations – AI powered "You may also like" suggestions on product pages. Context aware recommendations that surface products visitors would have missed.
Plugin Settings – Connect your Intufind workspace with one click. Paste your secret key and you're live. No external API keys needed.
Knowledge Sync – Choose which content types to sync for AI search and chat. Posts, pages, and WooCommerce products all supported with real time sync status.
Search Settings – Replace default WordPress and WooCommerce search with AI powered semantic search. Configure advanced options like mixed content search and cache duration.
Chat Settings – Enable the floating AI chat widget on your site and customize its appearance, behavior, and responses from the Intufind dashboard.
Recommendations – AI powered related products, upsells, and cross sells for WooCommerce. Replaces native suggestions with smarter, context aware recommendations.
Taxonomies – Enable product categories, tags, brands, and custom taxonomies for AI powered filtering and search refinement.
Dashboard Overview – The full Intufind workspace with sidebar navigation, workspace settings, and quick access to all features.
Analytics Closeup – Track products indexed, content synced, daily searches, and chats with 30 day usage trends and content breakdown.
Knowledge Base – View and manage all indexed products and content from the Intufind dashboard.
Chat Analytics – Monitor conversations, visitor engagement, average messages, and feedback satisfaction scores with trend tracking.
Theme Colors – Customize widget colors for light and dark modes. Use AI to generate a harmonious color palette from your brand color.
Prompts Manager – Create suggested questions that appear in your chat widget to guide visitors toward common topics.
Edit Prompt – Set custom prompts with canned responses for instant answers to frequently asked questions. Supports Markdown.
Live Agent Handoff – Connect Slack to receive live agent requests when the AI needs to escalate to your human support team.
API Keys – Manage secret and publishable API keys for custom integrations and advanced implementations.
